_comment: Light 55Fe Monte Carlo (tools/fe55_mc.py). Synthesizes full detector pulses and the 55Fe charge spectrum by superposing the MEASURED single-electron response over a realistic primary-electron cloud, with NO further Garfield runs. Inputs (scan products): --shape-dir (waveform_shapes.csv -> position-independent shape S(t'); waveform_drift.csv -> drift-delay map tau(x,y) + rms) and --gain-dir (per-position empirical gain = avalanche_size in the gain-scan roots). Model: 5.9 keV photon -> Ar-K photoabsorption -> photoelectron track (2.69 keV) + K-shell relaxation (Auger ~88% -> main peak; Ar Ka fluorescence ~12% -> escapes the thin gap -> escape peak, or reabsorbs -> satellite). Each primary electron drifts (delay from the map) and multiplies (gain drawn from the per-position distribution); the pulse is sum_i g_i*S(t-tau_i). Every value below is a physics knob; CLI flags (--n-photons/--seed/--tcut/--gain/--mode) override the 'run' block.

gas._atten_comment: X-ray attenuation lengths in Ar/CO2 70:30 at 1 atm. lam(5.9 keV)~16 cm >> 2.8 mm gap -> conversions ~uniform in depth. lam(2.96 keV, below the Ar K-edge) sets the Ar-fluorescence escape fraction from the thin gap (smaller -> more reabsorption -> weaker escape peak).

xray._lines_comment: 55Fe emits Mn Ka 5.895 keV (main) and Mn Kb 6.49 keV (~11%). 'Ka + escape' uses Ka only; add the Kb line with weight ~0.11 for the full spectrum.

track._comment: Low-energy electron practical range R[um] = range_um_at_1keV * (E/keV)^range_exponent at 1 atm (R(2.69 keV)~0.16 mm). straggle_frac = transverse spread as a fraction of the range.

diffusion._comment: Transverse electron diffusion during drift, sigma_x = coeff * sqrt(depth_cm). Minor correction; the longitudinal/arrival jitter is already carried by rms_drift_ns in the map.
